newsitem.title: USA: AOL new pricing scrutinzed by 15 states.
newsitem.headline: AOL new pricing scrutinzed by 15 states.

text.p: America Online Inc said that it has received an inquiry from 15 state attorneys general's offices, expressing concern about how the online service giant is implementing and disclosing its new pricing to members.

On December 1, America Online will switch all its seven million subscribers to a new pricing plan which provides unlimited use of the service for $19.95 a month, unless members specify to AOL that they want another pricing option.
"The plan is fair in every sense," said an AOL spokesman in Dulles, Va. "We are bending over backwards to make sure that all the members are aware of the new pricing."
